strategy_rules: Probabilities shown are the model's TRUE calibrated win probability — no display inflation (pitcher stats are point-in-time, no lookahead)
Only High (≈62%+ true win prob) and Elite (≈67%+) picks with confirmed market odds (|ML| ≤ 1500) qualify
Value gate: a leg must also beat the market's implied price by ≥1% edge (model win prob − book implied) — only genuine value, no thin-edge legs
Up to 3 qualifying picks → parlay (3-leg / 2-leg, sorted by win probability)
1 qualifying pick → single ML bet on the best pick
0 qualifying picks → skip, no bet today
Official ticket locks at the first 11 AM CT publish — it never changes later in the day even if the model retrains
Ratchet staking: stake % automatically scales down as bankroll grows to protect gains
